 Print The latest elimination in Bigg Boss Telugu 10 turned out to be an emotional one, as singer Jhansi’s journey on the show came to an end. While Jhansi was visibly upset by the announcement, Mukesh was hit the hardest. He broke down in tears, feeling responsible for her exit after using his special power to save Sudheer. Trigun also became emotional as the housemates bid farewell to Jhansi. This week’s elimination took an unexpected turn when Sudheer found himself in danger despite receiving fewer audience votes. Mukesh used the special power he had earned to save him, leaving the remaining contestants anxious about who would be evicted. Bigg Boss then introduced a special task for the five contestants in the Red Zone: Shiva, RK, Jhansi, Vamsi and Rohit. The housemates were given pots and hammers and asked to smash the pots to find the safe cards hidden inside. They then had to place those cards on the photographs of the contestants displayed on a board. When the task ended, all five contestants had an equal number of safe cards, leaving the final decision to Trigun. Four pots were placed in front of him, each containing the photograph of one of the contestants: RK, Vamsi, Shiva and Rohit. Jhansi’s photograph was missing, and Nagarjuna announced that she had been eliminated. Jhansi was emotional upon hearing the news, while Mukesh struggled to hold back his tears. He felt guilty that using his special power to save Sudheer had ultimately led to Jhansi’s exit. Trying to put his feelings into words, Mukesh told her, “I feel like I have done something wrong with my own hands. Please forgive me.” Jhansi, however, asked him not to cry and spoke about her time in the house. She said she was happy to have earned everyone’s love but had realised that her innocence would not help her in the game. She also made it clear that she did not want to change her personality for the sake of the competition. However, she expressed disappointment that her wish to bring her parents into the house had remained unfulfilled. As Jhansi prepared to leave, Mukesh hugged her and wished her a bright future, encouraging her to get a government job and fulfil her dream. Trigun was also seen getting emotional, saying that he considered her a younger sister as he consoled her. Jhansi’s elimination made for an emotional farewell, particularly for Mukesh, who continued to feel responsible for her exit. Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.
